# Source: Sampler (Map)

This GameCore theme is derived from a **specific, real, public-domain work**—not a generated palette.

## Work

- **Title:** Sampler (Map)
- **Artist / culture:** England
- **Date:** c. 1800
- **Style:** Unspecified
- **Classification:** textile
- **Department:** Textiles
- **AIC artwork ID:** 15132
- **Artwork page:** https://www.artic.edu/artworks/15132
- **Public-domain image:** https://www.artic.edu/iiif/2/bb513b07-82c7-cdd3-cca3-1fe729bc82e5/full/400,/0/default.jpg
- **Research category:** Map Design

## Extracted source palette

`#A8A8A8, #B89868, #987858, #786848, #C8A888, #684838, #A89888, #683818`

The image was downsampled deterministically and quantized to a four-bit-per-channel histogram.
Colors were ranked by pixel population and de-duplicated by RGB distance. No random values are used.

## Semantic adaptation

- `background`: `#3E3625`
- `surface`: `#544D3E`
- `on_surface`: `#F8F8F6`
- `primary`: `#B89868`
- `on_primary`: `#0C0C0E`
- `secondary`: `#683818`
- `surface_variant`: `#544D3E`
- `on_surface_variant`: `#F8F8F6`
- `outline`: `#726C60`
- `error`: `#B89868`
- `on_error`: `#0C0C0E`

- Font: `mono` (chosen from source style/classification)
- Corner radius: `16dp` (chosen from source object/design classification)
- Body contrast: background `11.23:1`, surface `7.87:1`
- Variant contrast: `7.87:1`
- Control contrast: `7.19:1`

Backgrounds retain a source hue but are toned toward neutral only when needed to ensure body text is
at least 7.0:1. The primary action remains an extracted source color and its ink is chosen
for at least 4.5:1.
